meta.title: Antigravity (agy) runner
meta.description: Runs Google Antigravity (agy acp) tasks as observable background ACP sessions. The agy tool starts a session and returns a job id immediately; job_output streams its tool calls, plan, and answer live, a completion notice arrives in-session, and job_kill cancels. Permission prompts are answered automatically by the configured policy (default: reject). Requires the agy CLI installed and signed in.
